description_zh: 调用该接口获取图片列表
name: QueryPictureFiles

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page of the IoT Platform console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to query information about all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the IPC device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page of the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is a globally unique identifier for the device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query range. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 检索范围起始时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query range. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 检索范围结束时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Pages start from 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。页数从1开始排序
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The image type. Valid values:

0: thumbnail. 
1: original image.
2 (default): all
parameters.help_zh:
图片类型：

0：缩略图。 
1：原图。
2（默认）：全部
parameters.name: picture_type

parameters.help_en:
The image source. Valid values:

0 (default): all events.
1: alert event capture.
2: active capture.
3: other.
4: cloud screenshot
parameters.help_zh:
图片来源：

0（默认）：全部事件。
1：告警事件抓图。
2：主动抓图。
3：其他。
4：云端截图
parameters.name: picture_source

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page of the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no<props="intl"><ph> Instance Overview page or</ph></props> ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en:
The response code.

200: success.
Other values: error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

IotId.description_en: The device ID of the IPC device

PicCreateTime.description_en: The time when the image was created. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
PicCreateTime.description_zh: 图片创建的时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒

PicUrl.description_en:
The image URL.

The URL is valid for 1 hour
PicUrl.description_zh:
图片URL。

URL有效期为1小时

ThumbUrl.description_en:
The thumbnail URL.

The URL is valid for 1 hour
ThumbUrl.description_zh:
缩略图URL。

URL有效期为1小时

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.

是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
